promotions.title: Fuel Savings — 8% Rebate at PETRON
promotions.tnc_summary: 8% fuel rebate at PETRON stations nationwide, capped at RM15/month. Rebate applies to the first RM188 fuel spend monthly. Debit and credit cards eligible; rebate posted as statement credit.

promotions.title: 0% Instalment Plan — Electronics & Home Appliances
promotions.tnc_summary: 0% interest instalment over 6, 12, or 24 months on purchases above RM500 at participating merchants. One-time upfront processing fee of 3% may apply for 24-month tenure. Early settlement subject to bank approval.

promotions.title: Visa Infinite — Complimentary Airport Lounge Access
promotions.tnc_summary: Up to 6 complimentary LoungeKey visits per year for the principal cardholder. Enrolment via the LoungeKey app required. Guest visits charged at USD32 each. Subject to annual income eligibility of RM150,000.

promotions.title: Public Bank Visa Signature — 10% Cashback on Dining
promotions.tnc_summary: 10% cashback on dining spend, capped at RM30/month. Minimum monthly retail spend RM1,500 to qualify. Cashback credited within 60 days. Public Bank Visa Signature principal cards only.

promotions.title: PB Quantum Mastercard — 5% Cashback on Online & Contactless
promotions.tnc_summary: 5% cashback on online and contactless transactions, combined cap RM30/month; 0.5% on other retail. Excludes bill payments, insurance, and government transactions. Requires minimum RM2,500 monthly spend for the full cap.
